title: Set the room box and probe position
author: claude
summary: We told the helper how big the room is and where the probe was taken.
what: We described the room as a box and told the helper where the probe was taken. The page sets this up once when it starts.
why: Box projection needs the room's real size and the probe's position to place reflections correctly.
how: The room is 8.6 m long, 3.2 m high and 6.2 m wide, and the probe sits 0.85 m above the floor in the middle.

tech.name: Box projection
tech.plain: A trick that makes reflections line up with the real walls instead of looking infinitely far away.

tech.name: 360-degree probe
tech.plain: A panorama of the room taken from the table. It lights and reflects in the table and chairs.
